description: React component for creating and editing invoices, including form handling, state management, and UI rendering.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: Hook for generating Material-UI styles used in the component.

methods.name: Invoice
methods.description: Main React functional component for invoice creation/editing, managing form state, handling user interactions, and rendering the invoice UI.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Updates the selected due date when the user picks a new date.

methods.name: handleRates
methods.description: Updates the VAT/rates state and invoice data when the user changes the rates input.

methods.name: handleDelivery
methods.description: Updates the delivery charge state and invoice data when the user changes the delivery input.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to individual invoice item fields.

methods.name: handleAddField
methods.description: Adds a new empty item row to the invoice items list.

methods.name: handleRemoveField
methods.description: Removes an invoice item row based on index.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an invoice.
